output.body:
# HIU, health information user

## In plain words

A health information user is the side of an exchange that wants records it
does not hold. It is identified by a service id, carried in the `X-HIU-ID`
header, which the specification describes as:

> Identifier of the health information user to which the request was intended

The same organisation often holds both roles, one for the records it keeps
and one for the records it wants to read.

## Before you start

You need a consent request the patient has approved, because this role reads
nothing without one.

## What happens

`m3_post_consent_v3_request_init` raises the consent request that this role
begins every exchange with.

## How you know it worked

You have understood this when you can say which role a consent request is
raised by and which role it is served against.

## When it goes wrong

Requesting health information on a consent artefact that has expired or been
revoked, which the specification states must not be done.

reply.Text:
**HIU (Health Information User)** is a role in the ABDM ecosystem that represents a system requesting health records it does not hold. Here are the key points:

- **Main function**: Asks a patient for consent and then fetches records held elsewhere (at other health repositories)
- **Identification**: Identified by a service ID carried in the `X-HIU-ID` header
- **Consent requirement**: Must have a patient-approved consent request before accessing any records — it reads nothing without one
- **Common scenario**: The same organization often holds both HIU and HIP (Health Information Provider) roles — one for the records it keeps and one for records it wants to read

**Examples of HIU use**:
- A pharmacy fetching a patient's prescription history from a hospital
- A diagnostic lab requesting prior test results from another facility
- An insurance company accessing treatment records for claims processing

The HIU flow begins with a consent request (via the `m3_post_consent_v3_request_init` operation) and progresses through fetching records once the patient approves.

See the [ABDM glossary](https://abdm-docs.nha.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary#hiu) for details.
